main_text.p: Achæum ex arce Sardium deduxit, & per insidias cepit. καὶ ἰδὼξι, addit, πρῶτον μὲν ἀκρωτηριάσαντ᾽ αὐτὸν τὰ ταλαίπωρον, εἶτ᾽ ἢ ταῦτα τὴν κεφαλὴν ἀπολιμψάμενος ἀνὴρ, καὶ πολλὰ ψυχὰς ἐξ ὄνου ἄσκων, ἀναστρωννύσα τὸ σῶμα: Et visum est, primò admutilare illum miserum & extremas partes succidere, deinde capite ejus resecto & in asininum culleum conjecto, reliquum corpus crucifigere. Hæc res: sperne aliorum inanes logos. Sed & mecum lege, teste Leviter emendatuspependit aquâ: non triste aut rectè, quod vulgatur. Vult enim, eum non in ipsâ aurifera aquâ, id est Pactolo, suspensum: quî potuit? sed juxta eam, atque illâ quasi arbitrâ & inspectante. Pactolus autem haud longè Sardes, ubi hæc gesta.

page.notes: Greek text in the body is partly illegible in the scan and is transcribed as best read; the marginal note "Leviter emendatus" and the "datus" fragment beside "aut" are doubtful; the word "CAP." at the foot is a catchword-like mark and is set as a foot line.
